content_sections.heading: About CRC Patna
content_sections.text: CRC Patna is an institute at Sheikhpura (Old Dharamshala), Near IGIMS Nursing College, Patna – 800014, which runs the B.P.O. (Bachelor in Prosthetics & Orthotics) course. The notice is signed by its Director, Priyadarshini.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration will be paid on a per-hour basis and commensurate with qualification & experience, as per prevailing norms in the Institute. The notice does not print an hourly amount. The syllabus of the concerned subjects may be made available to interested individuals by email. To get it, intimate CRC Patna at the email IDs given in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CRC Patna Guest Faculty (P&O)?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 11th November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for the CRC Patna Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Send your complete Bio-data and copies of relevant documents by email to [email protected] or [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Guest Faculty (P&O) at CRC Patna?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master in Prosthetics & Orthotics and a valid RCI Registration.

faq.question: Q4. Is experience required for CRC Patna Guest Faculty (P&O)?
faq.answer: Two years experience in Prosthetics & Orthotics is desirable, not listed as essential.

faq.question: Q5. How will Guest Faculty be paid at CRC Patna?
faq.answer: Remuneration is paid on a per-hour basis, commensurate with qualification and experience, as per prevailing norms in the Institute.

faq.question: Q6. Which course will the Guest Faculty teach?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty will teach B.P.O. (Bachelor in Prosthetics & Orthotics) – 1st Year.

faq.question: Q7. Can I get the syllabus before applying?
faq.answer: The syllabus of the concerned subjects may be made available to interested individuals by email, if they intimate CRC Patna at the email IDs given in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I send with the application?
faq.answer: Send your complete Bio-data and copies of relevant documents.
